svg.title: The stack, interface by interface
svg.desc: Table of eleven stack interfaces. For each: what the bolt-on reconstructs by inference, what the rebuild declares, and an order-of-work number from 1 to 4 matching the map. A references block at the bottom gives sources; unreferenced wording is labelled informed opinion.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: The stack, interface by interface

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: At every boundary the bolt-on reconstructs by inference what the layer below threw away. The rebuild writes the assumption down and checks it. The
order numbers match the map.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
text.tspan: interface

text.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
text.tspan: the bolt-on reconstructs

text.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
text.tspan: the rebuild declares

text.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
text.tspan: order

text.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Intent → program

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: A model guesses meaning from the prompt, every time, and
writes nothing back.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: The lossless Form: state, events, one total transition. Paid
once per new case.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Program → language

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Hundreds of surface languages, ports, rewrites, coding
tools that charge per generation.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Every language a byte-faithful projection of the Form. Lift
is the door in.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Language → compiler

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Optimizers recover structure the source destroyed;
undefined behavior at the edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: E-graph extraction by joules from a Form that already
carries the structure.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Program → runtime

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Schedulers guess priority, collectors guess liveness,
agents are sandboxed after the fact.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: The budget is declared. The runtime meters, schedules and
refuses under it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Runtime → silicon

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Branch prediction, caches, speculation: hardware spends
energy at run time reconstructing what the program already
knew. Estimates: mis-speculated work 6% [1] to about 28%
[2] of power (simulated cores); branch predictor 19 to 29%
of tile power (RTL estimate, SonicBOOM) [3]; about 70 pJ
per instruction against a few pJ for the operation (45 nm)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Bounded exploration declared; settle fabrics for the leaves
that fit them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Silicon → meter

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Counters stop at package (RAPL) [5] or board, averaged
over 1 s (NVML) [6]; published per-prompt figures divide
fleet energy by prompt count [7]. None is conditioned on a
correct result.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: The receipt, labeled by provenance, as a first-class output
of every run.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Agent ↔ agent, tool

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Schemas, retries, prompt-mediated tool use.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Typed effects, capability gates, commit certificates,
deterministic replay.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Proposal → acceptance

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Human review and tests as the gate; a score as the
evidence.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: A proof certificate at the boundary, then promotion. The
library that compounds.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Supply chain

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Registries store text; dependency resolution and CVE scans
run after the fact.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Hash-addressed verified fits. About 70% of files in 4.5
million non-fork GitHub projects are exact copies of earlier
files, from 40% (Java) to 94% (JavaScript) [8]; a clone
becomes a lookup.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Campus ↔ grid

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Demand response bolted onto uncontrolled load; power
bought, brought or built.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Budget-native plant. The cap is the design condition, not an
interruption.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Device ↔ cloud

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Upload everything to a model somewhere else.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Budget-native recognition at microwatts on the part already
in the product.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Order: 1 the loop (lift, Form, gate, promote) with 11 in parallel · 2 the meter (runtime, receipt) · 3 protocols and compiler · 4 silicon and grid, which move on
receipts, not arguments.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Row wording is the author's characterisation of each interface (informed opinion); bracketed numbers are sourced and scoped as stated.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: [1] Natarajan et al., UT Austin TR-2003-20 / ISLPED 2003, doi:10.1145/871506.871577: simulated Alpha 21264, flushed instructions about 6% of dynamic power.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: [2] Aragón, González, González, HPCA 2003: Wattch, 0.18 µm, 8-wide core, the 8 SPEC benchmarks with highest misprediction; 27.9% of power on mis-speculated instructions.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: [3] Chatzopoulos et al., ISPASS 2024: SonicBOOM RTL power estimate, ASAP7 7 nm predictive PDK; TAGE predictor 18.8% to 28.8% of tile power.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: [4] Horowitz, ISSCC 2014, doi:10.1109/ISSCC.2014.6757323: in-order core, 45 nm, 70 pJ per instruction vs a few pJ for an operation.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: [5] Linux kernel powercap documentation (Intel RAPL): package, core and uncore energy counters; no instantaneous power value.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: [6] NVIDIA NVML nvmlDeviceGetPowerUsage: GPU and associated circuitry; averaged over 1 s on Ampere (except GA100) and newer.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: [7] Elsworth et al. (Google), arXiv:2508.15734, 2025: median Gemini Apps text prompt 0.24 Wh, fleet power allocated per prompt.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: [8] Lopes et al., "DéjàVu," OOPSLA 2017, doi:10.1145/3133908: file-hash duplication, 85 million unique of over 428 million files.
